name: Cucco
description: A Cucco that reacts to player actions.

0.name: Passive
0.description: Does not flee from the player.

1.name: Aggressive
1.description: Attacks the player after being provoked repeatedly.

2.name: Large Fleeing Cucco
2.description: A large Cucco that quickly flees from the player and disappears.

3.name: Fleeing Cucco Group
3.description: Spawns three Cuccos that quickly flee from the player and disappear.

4.name: Flee and Disappear
4.description: Quickly flees from the player and disappears.

5.name: Carried
5.description: A Cucco being carried by the player.

6.name: Passive, Fleeing
6.description: Behaves like mode 0 but flees from the player.

7.name: Delayed Fleeing
7.description: Behaves like mode 6, but initially moves around.

fields.name: Player (Intern)
fields.description: Selects the player associated with the Cucco.

1.name: Large Cucco
1.description: Selects the larger Cucco rendering variant. Also affects sound selection and is propagated to spawned Cuccos.

2.name: Unknown Behavior
2.description: May affect the Cucco's fleeing behavior. Exact effect unknown.

4.name: Trigger-Activated
4.description: The Cucco appears only after its trigger variable is set.

8.name: Fast Movement
8.description: Makes the Cucco move significantly faster.

fields.name: Unknown Parameter
fields.description: Purpose and valid values have not been established.

fields.name: Trigger Variable
fields.description: The local variable number that triggers or activates this actor.
